name: René Moffatt & The Moonshadows at the Underground Music Showcase: Stuck Inside
seoTitle: René Moffatt & The Moonshadows, UMS: Stuck Inside
description: This is René Moffatt's full band, The Moonshadows, playing his song Stuck Inside on the Underground Music Showcase stage in Denver in the summer of 2026. For a dinner, he can also play solo with just his voice and an acoustic guitar.
